plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Makes the main session the one that implements, with three optional read-only helper subagents: planner and challenger on Opus, digger on Haiku, all at high effort. The planner plans complex work, the challenger questions a decision when an independent view adds value, and the digger investigates code, git history, docs and the web; none writes files or delegates, and no task requires one. With the jevKey option set (a TypeSafe key), Jev sizes only each helper call's effort, between medium and high; models stay at role defaults or fixed twin ids, and any Jev request or config failure requests the role default unless the agent has already sent its first step; that sends a redacted, truncated prompt to api.typesafe.ai. Each helper has a fixed-model crew:<role>-codex twin (planner and challenger on gpt-6-astra, digger on gpt-6-luna): behind a gateway other than Anthropic's API as ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, or with the codexLogin option on your Codex CLI login, where, with the crew Codex helper installed and running, all three twins run in codex app-server's read-only sandbox with Context7 and CodeGraph as fixed MCP tools, and without it crew sends the planner and challenger twins' requests to chatgpt.com's Codex backend. In the codex crew mode (the mode option, or /crew-mode for one session), a plain crew:<role> call runs on its registered twin, so its work goes to OpenAI. A HUD band above the prompt shows plan progress and running helpers, and /crew-hud opens a pane with each plan as a tree.

plugins.name: tailscale
plugins.description: Read or change your tailnet through the Tailscale API using the apiKey plugin option.
